observations: Two retail boxes for a wireless controller.
The boxes are labeled 'FOR SwitchP4ProPC/ClashAndroid' and 'Wireless Controller'.
The controller inside the box has a white base with green and yellow gradient lighting on the buttons.
A power cable with a UK-style three-pin plug is visible.
The actual controller is not shown outside of the packaging.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI GAME ARENA OFFICIAL' is present on the image.

claims.evidence: The boxes are for a SwitchP4Pro, not a PS4 Pro.

risks.risk: The controller may be a generic clone rather than the official SwitchP4Pro.
risks.proof: A photo of the controller outside of the box showing the model name on the faceplate.

risks.risk: The controller may be used or have internal damage.
risks.proof: A photo of the controller with the battery removed.

risks.risk: The power cable may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the controller being powered on and connected to a device.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the controller outside of the box.
Photo of the controller with the battery removed.
Photo of the controller's ports and buttons.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
